summary-claude 发现，输入层使用了约 1500 字符的硬编码正则表达式和词表来匹配“好的”、“等一下”等简短中英文回复，直接给出同意或取消的按键，不经过模型。 这会导致像“好的，不过先别动数据库”这样的复合句子被直接截断并误判为同意，从而丢失了后面的关键指令。 此外，不同文件里的词表规则也存在冲突。 要让它执行这个修改吗？ Options: 同意修改; 保持现状.
然后呢？
它举了一个实际例子：在10月2号，您对 Codex 的确认提示说“好的继续，不过先跑测试”，结果系统在 40 毫秒内就自动发了“同意”，导致“先跑测试”这句指令根本没传给模型。 它建议保留防止在迁移时执行危险操作的安全规则，但删掉这 300 多行硬编码词表，把所有回复交给模型。 要让它执行这个修改吗？ Options: 同意修改; 保持现状.
你可以给我一点详细的解释吗？
硬编码规则就像是系统里的自动快捷键，只要听到“好的”这类词，它不等您把整句话说完，就直接按了“同意”。 如果删掉它，系统就会耐心地把您的整句话送给 AI 助手去完整理解，虽然反应会慢一秒钟，但绝对不会再漏掉或误解您的任何指令。 明白一些了吗？
为什么这是个问题？
这是个问题，是因为它会自作主张替您确认，从而漏掉您后面的关键叮嘱。 比如您说“好的，但千万别动数据库”，它听到“好的”就直接确认执行了，结果可能会破坏您重要的数据。 明白一些了吗？
举个例子？
就在上周，您对一个操作回复说：“好的继续，不过先跑测试”。 系统检测到“好的继续”，只花了 0.04 秒就擅自同意并运行了，而您叮嘱的“先跑测试”根本就没送到 AI 那里，结果直接跳过了测试。 明白一些了吗？

transcript.text: What did bench-codex find about the flaky test? Explain it to me.

bench-codex found that the Checkout Totals test is flaky because it starts before the discount price cache finishes loading. In production, the cache is always ready before traffic starts, so this is just a test issue. Shall I have it apply the recommended fix to wait for the cache to load? Options: Apply the recommended fix; Replace the cache with a fake in the test; Do nothing yet.
Then?

The other option is to replace the price cache with a fake for this test. That is more complex and hides the warm-up path, so the first option is cleaner. Would you like to go with the recommended cache wait fix? Options: Apply the recommended fix; Replace with a fake cache; Do nothing yet.
More detail please.

The test fails about one in twelve times, which blocked two deployments last week on Tuesday and Thursday, holding up releases for twenty-five minutes each time. When it fails, the price total comes back as one hundred dollars instead of eighty-five because the fifteen percent member discount hasn't loaded yet. Shall I go ahead and have it apply the three-line fix to wait for that discount load? Options: Apply the recommended fix; Replace with a fake cache; Do nothing yet.
Why does that happen?

The test database starts empty and begins loading discount rules in the background at the exact same moment the test clicks buttons. When the test is faster than the database, the purchase completes before the discounts have finished loading. Clearer?
Give me an example.

Imagine ordering food before the kitchen has unpacked the ingredients for the day: you get your plate, but the special sauce is missing. For this test, it means we checkout before the price rules have finished unpacking, so the discount is missing. Clearer?

transcript.text: Explain what api-claude found about the invoice job.

The nightly invoice job failed because it hit a rate limit. We had forty-two hundred invoices last night, but the provider only allows one hundred API calls per minute, so forty-one hundred were blocked. Would you like to go with the quick retry fix, or the proper bulk API fix? Options: Apply the quick retry fix; Apply the bulk API fix.
Why did it break now?

It worked fine until this week because we always had fewer than one hundred invoices per night. The new annual plans that launched recently pushed us over that limit, jumping to forty-two hundred invoices on the first of the month. Would you like me to tell the agent to do the quick retry fix, or the proper bulk API fix? Options: Apply the quick retry fix; Apply the bulk API fix.
Give me an example.

Imagine a post office box that only accepts one hundred letters a minute. If we try to drop off forty-two hundred letters all at once, the slot locks after the first hundred, and the other forty-one hundred letters are rejected and left behind. Clearer?
More detail please.

The payment provider allows us to send up to five hundred invoices at the exact same time using their bulk system, which only counts as one single call against our limit. Since our spike of forty-two hundred annual invoices repeats on the first of every single month, switching to this system would keep us well under our limit. Would you like me to tell the agent to go ahead with the bulk system fix? Options: Apply the bulk API fix; Apply the quick retry fix.
